Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Sentences, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we achieve sentence variety in communication?
